a_desc: A Southern mutant who absorbs powers by touch
b_desc: Founder of the anti-mutant Friends of Humanity

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#59
stages.text: Graydon is the son of Rogue's foster mother Mystique. Plotting to wipe out his mutant family to win back the Friends of Humanity, he lures Rogue, Kurt and Wolverine into a deadly trap.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Rogue's foster brother, who wants her dead.

a_desc: The late Wolverine, his world's anchor being

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Laura was bred from Logan's DNA, and Charles calls her his daughter. Logan at first wants nothing to do with her, then gives his life to protect her, and she calls him her father as he dies.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: His daughter Laura, bred from his DNA.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Her father, who dies protecting her.

a_desc: The Invisible Woman, who turns invisible
b_desc: The Human Torch, who bursts into flame
titles_to_check: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer

stages.title: Fantastic Four (2005)
stages.text: Sue and Johnny are sister and brother. She keeps trying to rein in her reckless younger brother, and together they wrap Doom in fire to beat him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Sue's reckless younger brother, and her teammate in the Fantastic Four.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Johnny's older sister, who keeps trying to rein him in.

a_desc: Daredevil, a vigilante with heightened senses

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Matt falls in love with Elektra, and they share their first kiss on a rooftop. Believing Daredevil killed her father, she fights him and learns who he is just before Bullseye strikes her down.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The woman Matt loves. Fights him to avenge her father.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The man Elektra loves, who she learns is Daredevil.

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Nikolas is Elektra's father, a businessman tied to the Kingpin. When he tries to break away, Bullseye kills him and makes it look like Daredevil's work.

a_desc: A veteran Spider-Man, settled with Mary Jane

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Ben is Peter's uncle, who raises him with May. He tells Peter that with great power comes great responsibility, and that same night he is shot by a carjacker.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's uncle, killed the night Peter let a thief escape.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Ben's nephew, whom he raised and taught about responsibility.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Years later, Peter tells two other Peters that Ben's death was his fault, and that hunting down the man he blamed did not make it better. Ben's words about power and responsibility turn out to bind all three of them.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's late uncle, whose words he still lives by.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Ben's nephew, still carrying Ben's words years later.

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: May and Ben are a married couple who raise their nephew Peter in Queens. Ben is shot dead by a carjacker, leaving May a widow.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: May's husband, shot dead by a carjacker.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Ben's wife, who raises Peter with him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Harry dates Mary Jane, but he sees that she is falling for Peter, and it hurts him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Mary Jane's boyfriend, Peter's best friend.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Harry's girlfriend, who is falling for Peter.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: While Peter grows distant, Mary Jane leans on Harry as a friend, and they share a kiss she regrets. When his memory returns, Harry threatens Peter to force her to leave him, then dies in the fight to save her from Venom and the Sandman.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Mary Jane's old friend, who forces her breakup, then dies fighting to save her.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Harry's old friend, whom he forces to leave Peter.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Richard is May's brother-in-law, who leaves his son Peter in her and Ben's care.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Mary Parker is May's sister-in-law, who leaves her son Peter with May and Ben.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Jefferson and Rio are married and raise their son Miles together in Brooklyn.

stages.text: Jiaying is Kora's mother and raises her in Afterlife, trying to keep her unstable power in check. Kora breaks with her to follow Nathaniel Malick.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Kora's mother, who raised her in Afterlife.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Jiaying's daughter, who turns against her for Nathaniel Malick.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#10
stages.text: Jiaying begs S.H.I.E.L.D. to bring Kora back to her from Afterlife, but Nathaniel Malick, the man Kora turned on her to follow, kills Jiaying at the Lighthouse.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Kora's mother, killed by Nathaniel Malick.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Jiaying's daughter, who turns against her for Nathaniel Malick.
